validation.description: Test padded packets for security properties
requirements: Should use cryptographically secure random padding
Should not leak information through padding patterns
Should maintain consistent packet structure regardless of padding
Should detect tampering with padded packets
Should handle different padding seeds correctly

security_tests.expected_result: No discernible patterns in padding bytes

security_tests.description: Attempt to replay a padded packet

security_tests.expected_result: Server should detect and reject tampered packets
No information leakage through padding errors

statistical_tests: Padding bytes should have uniform distribution
Padding should be different for identical packets
